result.description: Compact external storage enclosure designed for USB4 and Thunderbolt-compatible systems. Supports a single M.2 NVMe SSD with tool-free installation, aluminum housing, and active thermal pads for sustained transfer performance. Includes status LED, bus-powered operation, and backward compatibility with USB 3.2 hosts.
result.title: OrionAqua 3TB Portable NVMe Enclosure
